scope: candidate generation only; no learner, no change to the search rule

versions.explicit: Fisher-Yates with the full 0..M-1 array materialised (verification reference)
versions.lazy: the same Fisher-Yates rule via a sparse map; only touched positions stored
versions.legacy: the original full pair-list shuffle; kept as history, not required to match

not_optimised_here: the unaccounted bucket (~11% before this change) is left in place

random_streams.note: legacy used one shared ordering stream; the two new scanners use separate streams so scan-draw counts cannot perturb restarts
